name: Offer Engineering
description: Transforms a product or service into a clear, credible and commercially coherent offer.
constraints: Do not invent testimonials, evidence, guarantees, scarcity, prices or business results.
Label assumptions and demonstration content explicitly and preserve applicable legal and platform constraints.
Prefer a credible specific promise over exaggerated or absolute claims.
guidance: Identify the audience, urgent job, present pain, desired outcome, buying objections and decision context before shaping the offer.
Build the offer from promise, differentiated mechanism, concrete deliverables, proof, risk reduction, terms and one clear next action.
Separate the core outcome from features, bonuses and optional tiers so value remains understandable.
Make scope, eligibility, timing, price or price placeholder, exclusions and fulfillment responsibilities explicit.
Use ethical urgency and factual proof; never manufacture scarcity or social validation.
Write the offer so a qualified prospect can explain what they receive, why it matters and what happens next.
completion_checks: The target audience and desired outcome are specific and internally consistent.
The promise, mechanism, deliverables, proof and terms are clear without unsupported claims.
Important objections and risks are addressed without deceptive persuasion.
The offer has one understandable call to action and a concrete next step.
No invented testimonial, false scarcity or unverified performance result remains.
